# Qafri Tours & Travels

> Bespoke African journeys, curated safaris, and corporate travel logistics with editorial precision.

Qafri Tours & Travels is a luxury travel agency offering bespoke safaris, air ticketing, visa assistance, hotel reservations, and concierge logistics across Africa and beyond.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, featured safaris, and inquiry bar.
- [Safaris](/safaris): Curated luxury safari expeditions including Maasai Mara, Rwanda gorillas, and the Namib desert.
- [Services](/services): Air ticketing, visa assistance, hotel reservations, MICE, car rentals, and travel insurance.
- [Contact](/contact): Request a bespoke travel plan from our experts.
